description: The specified inclusion of shared first-order formulas into infinitary syntax preserves and reflects satisfaction, using the same structure, free assignment, and protected bound-slot assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_ofFirstOrder.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [Finite α] {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] (φ : L.BoundedFormula α n) (a : α → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.ofFirstOrder φ) a b ↔
    φ.Realize a b
